examples.title: Default
examples.code:
<Filters Fields="_fields" @bind-Query="_query" ShowClear="true" />

@code {
    private readonly IReadOnlyList<FilterField> _fields = new[]
    {
        new FilterField { Id = "title", Label = "Title" },
        new FilterField { Id = "status", Label = "Status", Kind = FilterValueKind.Select,
            Options = new[] { new FilterChoice("draft", "Draft"), new FilterChoice("published", "Published") } },
        new FilterField { Id = "tags", Label = "Tags", Kind = FilterValueKind.MultiSelect, Options = _tags },
        new FilterField { Id = "amount", Label = "Amount", Kind = FilterValueKind.Number },
        new FilterField { Id = "created", Label = "Created", Kind = FilterValueKind.Date },
        new FilterField { Id = "archived", Label = "Archived", Kind = FilterValueKind.Boolean },
    };
    private FilterQuery _query = FilterQuery.Empty();

    // What an API call needs: field, operator, values, negated
    IReadOnlyList<FilterTerm> Terms => _query.Flatten();
}

**Package:** `Lumeo.DataGrid` · **Category:** Data Display/Tables
**Docs:** https://lumeo.nativ.sh/components/filters

## Slots
- `Trigger` (Filters) — Replaces the add-filter button; the popover opens on its click.
- `ValueTemplate` (Filters) — Custom rendering of every chip's value segment.
- `ChipTemplate` (Filters) — Replaces the whole chip for a rule.
- `ChildContent` (Filters) — A custom layout: receives the cascaded FiltersContext and renders the bar itself.
- `Trigger` (FiltersAdvanced) — RenderFragment slot
- `EmptyTemplate` (FiltersAdvancedPanel) — Replaces the empty state.
- `Trigger` (FiltersBuilder) — Replaces the button.

## Events
- `QueryChanged` (`EventCallback<FilterQuery>`)
- `OnQueryChanged` (`EventCallback<FilterQueryChange>`) — Fires after every change with the new query and why it changed.
- `OnConvertToAdvanced` (`EventCallback`) — Fires when the user picks "Advanced editor" in a chip menu; the entry only shows while set.
